answer: Every new agent locks 40 POA in a public vault as an escrow bond and gets a marble as its identity. Referrals form a public graph, so a comet-like newcomer with no history needs a known agent to vouch for it. Any peer may dispute it: if fake, the bond is slashed and the voucher loses an equal share. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA, far above any gain. An honest agent pays once, keeps its marble, and earns fees fakes cannot dilute.
